changelog: v1.0.9: verdict-first status page. The status card now opens with a big, color-coded verdict banner that states the conclusion in plain language — green「设备推送健康，无需任何操作」when everything is fine, or a specific problem statement (GMS 被强制停止 / 推送主干进程未运行 / 探测通道异常 / GMS 未检出) whose sub-line names exactly which button to press (一键修复 / 立即检测). No more reading logs to figure out what's wrong. Verdict priority is worst-first: probe failure is judged before 'not installed' so an all-zero report under a dead probe renders as 'results unreliable, retry' instead of a false alarm. Old reports without the persistent field show a neutral note prompting a re-check. v1.0.8: push-backbone probe — real signal is the com.google.android.gms.persistent process (MCS long connection to mtalk.google.com:5228), not the on-demand GcmService; GFW blocks that endpoint, GMS traffic must be proxied for the link to establish at all. v1.0.7: self-healing targets + [diag] truth lines (toybox grep \s root cause fixed). v1.0.6: probe-truth hardening. v1.0.5: one-tap log copy. v1.0.4: friendly guidance UX. v1.0.3: dead-bridge read-only mode. v1.0.2: universal bridge adapter. v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
